title: Japanese/English Exchange group ENKAI（縁会）
description:
日本語と英語で話そう！Let's join Japanese/English Exchange group ENKAI（縁会）!

Learn Japanese/English, make friends, learn about culture!All Levels Welcome!Are you looking for opportunities to practice your Japanese or English? Have fun meeting new people while practicing your target language with native speakers. Plus, you get to return the favor and help others reach their goal to become fluent in another language! Not only will you walk away feeling like you've improved your English or Japanese, but you'll also feel great about helping someone else reach his or her goals. Let's enjoy ENKAI!

This event only allows attendees that are 18 years old or older.

Fee: $11 to be paid at the counter (Includes regular flat white, coffee, tea, or a fizzy drink)

title: 📌Kaipara harbour coastal
description:
***Join us on Sunday, October 4th for the Kaipara Coast to Shelly Beach Hike as we explore the shores of the Kaipara Harbour—the largest natural harbour in the Southern Hemisphere! Starting at South Head, we will make our way south along the coastline to Shelly Beach, taking in vast tidal flats, coastal farmland, sand beaches, and mangroves along the way. While no swimming is required, you can expect wading and some muddy patches, so come prepared to get partially wet. Please note that this hike requires a car shuttle, and details are in this description.***
📌 New members are welcome
📌 If you find yourself on the "waiting list" and decide to attend the hike on the day of the event, then please be aware that you will need to hike separately from the group. Only those listed as "Going" are considered valid participants.
There are no "plus ones"- If you want to go, then you will need to register with meetup
📌 Individuals who are unfit or prefer a slower pace are kindly requested not to RSVP. Slow people will hold up the group, as everyone will have to wait for you to catch up. There are alternative Meetup groups available for those who enjoy walking very slowly.
📌If you are unable to attend, please update your status to avoid a "No Show" being recorded next to your name. Accumulating three or more "No Shows" will result in your status being changed to "Not going." It is always polite to adjust your RSVP status if you can no longer participate. Thank you👍

🚩Summary of Main Details:
📌 Meet: Wellington St Convenience store (unless a direct driver)
📌 Hike Duration: Approx 6.5 hours including breaks (estimated)
📌 Distance: About 20km
📌 Map of hike: https://tinyurl.com/3af794v4
📌 Difficulty: 3.0 on our 1-5 scale.
📌 Speed: medium to fast pace
📌 Toilets: None - find some bushes.

title: Deep Dive into Jev & System One Models
description:
Looking for a chill but productive space to code, learn, and connect with other developers? Whether you’re just starting out or deep into a side project, you’re welcome here.

🔥 **This Fortnight's Spotlight: Jev & System One Models** Tired of wrestling with LLMs that hallucinate, break your JSON, and take 10 seconds to respond? This week, we're doing a quick 10-minute demo on **Jev** by TypeSafe AI—a brand new "System One" AI model.
Instead of acting like a chatbot that generates strings word-by-word, Jev acts like a lightning-fast function call. You give it unstructured data, and it outputs perfectly typed, probabilistic decisions in under 500 milliseconds. We'll look at why this parallel architecture is a game-changer for AI automation in your apps, and run a live demo of it in action.

🌟 **The Vibe & Details:** Alongside the demo, this remains a casual, community-driven space where you can:

• 💻 Work on your own coding projects
• 🎯 Share goals or progress (totally optional!)
• 🎙️ Talk tech, app development, and AI integration • ☕ Meet like-minded people over coffee

Come with your laptop, your curiosity, or just a love for tech. Stay for the connections and good vibes. No pressure, no strict schedule—just code, coffee, and vibes.

☕ *Note: This event is hosted at a local café, so we kindly ask that you support the venue by purchasing a drink or snack if you can.*

📅 We usually hold meetups every fortnight (bi-weekly)—use them to connect, share, and learn from others.

📚 **Want to geek out before you arrive? Check out these pre-reads:**

* [Introducing System One Models & Jev](http://typesafe.ai/blog/introducing-system-one-models-and-jev?utm_source=gemini) *(TypeSafe AI's official technical blog post)*
* [System One Models Explained](https://www.datacamp.com/blog/system-one-models-jev?utm_source=gemini) *(A great 10-minute summary by DataCamp)*
